summary: Iter 168 — Content-language follow-ups verified end-to-end on shared backend + web + mobile. Backend 10/10 pytest pass (test_iter168_lang_scopes_radio.py): (1) POST /api/radio/start returns 200 with session_id + segment for BOTH morning_masala (seg d9343a05...) and retro_lounge (seg 97ec81b7...); GET /api/radio/segment/{id} returns Content-Type audio/mpeg with real bytes (1024+ bytes streamed, no 409 build_failed/empty_playable_pool). (2) PATCH /api/users/content-languages accepts content_lang_scopes (full+partial body — partial preserves other keys) and persists on preference_vector — visible via /users/me AND /auth/me. (3) Per-section scope gating on /api/radio/browse: show_all=1742, music_off=1742 (filter disabled → unfiltered), music_on=1363 (filter active). show_all_languages=true correctly overrides scopes (1742). Games/quiz scopes accepted but sample data yields identical counts (72/72 games, 5/5 trivia categories) for english demo — no bollywood-tagged sample data to demonstrate delta, but the scope switch does not 500 either direction. (4) Home rails: /api/shell/home for_you cards carry `language` field (e.g. 'english') and safety net holds ≥4 cards on all scope states (for_you=6, mixed=9); no 500s, all prior fields intact (live_now, native_offer, listening_reward, dining, is_premium, top_genre, fuusic_world, together_actions, pillar_order, home_config). Web Profile: all 5 testIDs render (pref-show-all-languages, pref-lang-scopes, pref-scope-music, pref-scope-games, pref-scope-quiz); toggling music OFF + Save Preferences persists to preference_vector.content_lang_scopes={music:false,games:true,quiz:true} (verified via /users/me), toast 'Preferences updated' shown. Web Onboarding: step 2/11 Languages, English pre-selected (aria-pressed=true, class 'is-on') for demo user with saved language — detection does NOT override saved value; navigator.language detection code present at Onboarding.js:198 (en-US default). Mobile Profile → Edit preferences shows 'Show content in all languages' toggle + 'Apply my language filter to:' block with pref-scope-music, pref-scope-games, pref-scope-quiz (all 4 testIDs visible), tapping music unchecks the row and Save Preferences button tappable. Demo user RESTORED to {languages:['english'], show_all_languages:false, content_lang_scopes:{music:true,games:true,quiz:true}} — confirmed via /users/me at end.
critical_code_review_comments: Games/quiz scope filters cannot be empirically differentiated on the demo dataset — /api/games_v2/play_and_win returns 72 items with games=on vs games=off (identical), /api/trivia/categories returns 5 with quiz=on vs quiz=off (identical). This suggests either (a) no bollywood/hindi-tagged games/trivia are seeded so english users see the same set, or (b) the filter is a no-op on the current data. Music scope IS proven working (1742 unfiltered vs 1363 filtered). Recommend main agent seed a hindi/bollywood game + trivia category to demonstrate gating end-to-end; not blocking since the switch does not error and PATCH persists the scopes correctly.

mixed_for_you rail cards in /api/shell/home do NOT carry a top-level `language` field (only for_you does). Cards there follow a different shape (title/subtitle/badge/image/to) — spec asks 'for_you/mixed_for_you station cards now carry a language field'. Consider adding language to mixed_for_you station-type items for parity.

Home safety net was not visibly triggered — even with music_scope=false, home returned the same 6/9 for_you/mixed cards (not obviously wider). Could indicate scope=false isn't propagating to /shell/home, OR that the english-filtered pool already ≥ safety threshold so no fallback needed. Non-blocking (no 500, cards ≥4).
seed_data_creation: None new. Radio start relies on scripts/seed_demo_tracks.py 16 demo tracks (persisted in Mongo). ffmpeg is present at /usr/bin/ffmpeg (5.1.9-0+deb12u1). demo_track_10.mp3 cached locally and served as segment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radio audio pipeline PROVEN working end-to-end for demo user across at least 2 AI channels (morning_masala + retro_lounge) with real audio/mpeg bytes. Per-section scopes: music gating provably works on /api/radio/browse (1742→1363 flip); games/quiz gating accepts the scope but current english-user sample data shows identical counts (no bollywood/hindi tagged games/trivia seeded). Home rails carry `language` on for_you cards but NOT on mixed_for_you — flag if main agent wants full parity. Web onboarding auto-detect: code path present (Onboarding.js:198 navigator.language slice(0,2)), preserves saved lang for existing users. Web+mobile Profile testIDs: pref-show-all-languages, pref-lang-scopes (web only), pref-scope-music, pref-scope-games, pref-scope-quiz — all render and persist through POST /api/users/preferences or PATCH /api/users/content-languages. Demo user restored to defaults at test end (verified via /users/me: scopes={music,games,quiz:true}, languages=['english'], show_all_languages=false).
